title: Operation Fortune: Ruse de Guerre
synopsis: A top spy is sent to stop a wealthy arms dealer from selling a stolen device with dangerous AI potential. He assembles a quirky team and goes undercover among the rich and powerful.
notes: Guy Ritchie film. Full title is Operation Fortune: Ruse de Guerre.

title: Kandahar
synopsis: A covert operative has his cover blown after sabotaging a facility in Iran and must cross hostile Afghan territory with his translator to reach extraction.
notes: Gerard Butler. Not the 2001 Iranian film also called Kandahar.

title: The Ritual Killer
synopsis: A detective hunts a serial killer who removes organs from victims in ritual fashion, with help from a professor of African studies.
notes: Morgan Freeman stars. Violent content.

title: Extrapolations
synopsis: Linked stories set between 2037 and 2070 show how a warming planet changes the lives of people across the world.
notes: Apple TV+ original, runtime per episode is roughly 45 to 58 min (50 is an approximate midpoint). Streaming service is the original platform, not verified via JustWatch Ireland.

title: Assassin
synopsis: A private military firm uses mind-transfer tech to send agents into other bodies on covert missions. After an agent dies, his wife takes over the role to find the killer.
notes: Matched by the March 31, 2023 date (Bruce Willis's late film). Other films share the name Assassin, so check this is the one you meant.

title: Dungeons & Dragons: Honor Among Thieves
synopsis: A bard and a barbarian gather a mismatched crew to pull off a heist for a powerful relic, while a villain plots something far worse for the city.
notes: Matched by March 31, 2023 date. Not the 2000 D&D film or the 1980s cartoon.

title: Paint
synopsis: The star of a local public television painting show sees his place threatened when a younger, more versatile painter joins the station.
notes: Owen Wilson. Apple TV page exists for the Irish store, so it may be rentable/buyable there; not confirmed as streaming.

title: Beautiful Disaster
synopsis: A college student with a gambling past falls for a fighter in an underground fight club, and her family's debts threaten to drag her back to her old life.
notes: Based on Jamie McGuire's novel. Contains some sexual content typical of a romance drama.

title: Transfusion
synopsis: A former special forces soldier is pulled into the criminal underworld in a bid to keep his son.
notes: Australian film with Sam Worthington. No Wikipedia page found, facts taken from an Apple TV listing; runtime 1h46 from that page.

title: The Weapon
synopsis: A lone fighter takes on drug cartels and biker gangs while trying to rescue his ex from a crime boss.
notes: Plot taken from a Common Sense Media summary (reworded). Several films share this title; this one matches the Feb 17, 2023 date.

title: The Portable Door
synopsis: Two new interns at a strange London company discover its bosses are running magic like a business and set out to find what the firm is really up to.
notes: Based on Tom Holt's 2003 novel. Released in Australia 23 March 2023.

title: Hello Tomorrow!
synopsis: In a retro-styled future, a con man leads a team selling lunar real estate that may never be delivered, then finds the son he never knew.
notes: Apple TV+ original, episodes are 30 to 33 min. Whether a second season was renewed or cancelled was not stated on the page I read, so status is Unknown. Streaming service is the original platform, not checked on JustWatch Ireland.

title: Project E
notes: Could not identify. Searches for a Nov 9, 2022 release found only unrelated or obscure hits (Project E short on IMDb, Project EA 2022, Project E.1337: ALPHA). Possibly a typo or a foreign-language title; please check the original note.

title: War of the Worlds: The Attack
noted_as: War of the Worlds: The Attack
synopsis: Three teenagers see a cylinder land near their town and get caught up in an alien invasion as war machines wreck everything around them.
notes: Low-budget British live-action take on H.G. Wells, directed by Jay Syed. Not the 2005 Spielberg film or the Amazon series. Facts from a review site and BBFC, no Wikipedia page found.

title: Simulant
synopsis: A grieving widow activates a humanoid robot loaded with her late husband's memories, and it starts to act beyond its programming.
notes: Actual title is singular, Simulant. Canada release was April 7, 2023; June 2, 2023 was the later wider release.

title: Silo
synopsis: Thousands of people live in a huge underground silo ruled by strict laws, and an engineer starts to dig into the secrets of its past.
notes: Based on Hugh Howey's Wool/Shift/Dust. Three seasons aired, a fourth and final season is announced for July 2027. Runtime 41 to 62 min per episode (50 approximate). Streaming service is the original platform, not checked on JustWatch Irelan

title: Colonials
synopsis: A young man from a Mars colony is sent to Earth to learn what happened to a silent resistance, crash-lands with no memory, and is hunted by robot assassins.
notes: Low-budget indie sci-fi. Runtime from BBFC listing (about 80 min). No Wikipedia page found.

title: The Tomorrow Job
synopsis: Thieves take a drug that swaps them with their future selves to pull off a heist, then must fix their past mistakes when it goes wrong.
notes: Directed by Bruce Wemple. Limited theatres Jan 13, 2023, VOD Jan 17. Runtime 1h45 from Yidio.

title: The Hunger Games: The Ballad of Songbirds & Snakes
noted_as: The Hunger Games: The Ballad of Songbirds and Snakes
synopsis: A prequel set decades before the original story, following a young Coriolanus Snow as he mentors a tribute in the tenth Hunger Games.
notes: Based on Suzanne Collins's prequel novel. Runtime 2h38 from a runtime article; Wikipedia page fetch failed.

title: The Ark
synopsis: A century from now, a colony ship bound for another star loses most of its senior crew in a disaster, and the survivors have to keep it running and on course.
notes: Syfy series. Wikipedia infobox says 33 episodes but season tables list 36 (12 per season), so episode count left blank. Third season renewal reported March 2025; current status not confirmed.

title: Hypnotic
synopsis: A detective searching for his missing daughter clashes with a powerful hypnotist and finds his own life is not what it seems.
notes: Robert Rodriguez film with Ben Affleck. US release May 12, 2023.

title: Sakra
synopsis: A martial arts leader is cast out after his foreign birth is revealed and a murder is pinned on him, and he sets out to find the true culprit.
notes: Donnie Yen film based on Jin Yong's Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils. Opened in Asia in January 2023; release_from_note of April 14, 2023 likely refers to a later release elsewhere. Also known as Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils.

title: The Square
synopsis: A museum curator's life unravels after a theft and a controversial marketing campaign for a new art installation.
notes: Your note was 'The Square / Triangle of Sadness', split into two entries. Both are by Ruben Ostlund, which supports The Square (2017) being the one meant. Other films called The Square exist (e.g. 2008 Australian thriller).

title: Triangle of Sadness
synopsis: A model couple joins a luxury yacht cruise where the crew serves the rich guests, until a disaster leaves survivors stranded and the class order flips.
notes: Split from the combined note 'The Square / Triangle of Sadness'. Contains crude humour, vomiting and some nudity.

title: The Last Voyage of the Demeter
synopsis: Aboard a merchant ship carrying a strange cargo to London, the crew is hunted one by one by a vampire hiding on board.
notes: Based on a chapter of Bram Stoker's Dracula. Horror with gore.

title: Perfect Blue
synopsis: A pop idol leaves her group to become an actress and is pursued by an obsessive fan as the line between her real life and her roles blurs.
notes: Satoshi Kon's debut, loosely based on a novel by Yoshikazu Takeuchi. Mature film: graphic violence, a simulated sexual assault scene and nudity, but it is not hentai. The 'August 5, 1997' date in your note is the premiere period; general Ja

title: The Crowded Room
synopsis: A young man is arrested after a shooting in 1979 New York and gradually tells an interrogator about his troubled past. Tom Holland leads the cast.
notes: Apple TV+ limited series. Episodes run about 38 to 56 minutes (47 is a midpoint). Released 9 June 2023, matching the note.

title: Problemista
synopsis: An aspiring toy designer from El Salvador in New York takes a job with an eccentric art-world outcast while racing to find a new visa sponsor before his work visa runs out.
notes: Premiered in 2023; the wide release was in 2024, so the 4 August 2023 date in the note may be a local or festival date that I could not verify.

title: No Hard Feelings
synopsis: A broke Long Island woman takes an odd job from a pair of anxious parents: to befriend their shy son before he goes off to college. Jennifer Lawrence stars.
notes: The Wikipedia page I fetched was a disambiguation page, so the runtime (103) comes from my own knowledge and is not verified. It is an R-rated sex comedy but not explicit. Several unrelated titles share the name; the owner's 23 June 2023 da

title: The Creator
synopsis: In 2070 a former special forces agent is sent to hunt down the architect of an AI weapon that could end the war between humans and artificial intelligence.
notes: Assumed to be the 2023 Gareth Edwards film as no year was given; other films share the title.

title: Quiz Lady
synopsis: A trivia-obsessed woman is dragged by her chaotic older sister into a TV quiz show to raise money and rescue their dog from a loan shark.

title: Monarch: Legacy of Monsters
synopsis: Set in the Godzilla film universe, the series follows people tied to the Monarch organisation as they chase giant monsters across two time periods fifty years apart.
notes: Apple TV+ series. Season 1 started 17 Nov 2023; season 2 began 27 Feb 2026 per Wikipedia (listed as ongoing, so check whether it has finished). Episodes run about 40 to 54 minutes (47 is a midpoint).

title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutant Mayhem
synopsis: Four teenage mutant turtles raised in the New York sewers try to win acceptance from humans while facing a gang of mutants led by a villain called Superfly.
notes: AMBIGUOUS: 'TMNT' also fits the 2007 animated film TMNT, the 2014 live-action film, and several TV series. I picked Mutant Mayhem (2023) because the neighbouring notes are 2023 titles, but this is a guess; please confirm.

title: The Bad Guys
synopsis: A gang of notorious animal criminals pretends to go straight after getting caught, but their leader starts to genuinely want a better life.
notes: A sequel, The Bad Guys 2, exists (2025); this entry is the 2022 original as noted.

title: Fireheart
synopsis: In 1940s New York a young woman disguises herself as a man to join a new group of firefighters who are chasing a mysterious arsonist.
notes: Animated (CGI) Canadian-French family film, not anime. Assumed this 2022 film as no year was given.

title: Boy Kills World
synopsis: A deaf and mute fighter trains for years to avenge his family against a ruling dynasty that stages an annual televised purge, guided by an inner voice from a childhood video game.
notes: Very violent (R-rated), not sexual. Premiered at TIFF 2023; US release April 2024.

title: Argylle
synopsis: A reclusive spy novelist discovers that her latest book seems to mirror real espionage events and gets pulled into the real thing.

title: Towa no Quon
synopsis: In a near-future Japan, people with special powers called Dimensioners are hunted by a secret organisation while a leader named Agni fights to protect them.
notes: A series of six theatrical films (Bones, 2011), each about 50 to 60 minutes, so no single runtime is given. Total is roughly 5 to 6 hours. The Wikipedia page also shows a stray '2000' date but 2011 is the release year. Based on a manga.

title: World Trigger
synopsis: Gates to another world open over a city and alien creatures called Neighbors invade, so a defence agency fights back with special weapons. A mysterious transfer student and a cautious trainee end up working together.
notes: Season 1: 73 eps (2014-16), season 2: 12 eps (2021), season 3: 14 eps (2021-22). A reboot of season 1 was announced in December 2025, so a new version may appear. One of the original notes pairs it with 'D.Grayman', which is a separate titl

title: KamiKatsu: Working for God in a Godless World
synopsis: A cult leader's son wakes in what looks like another world but is really a future where the gods are gone, and he sets out to revive a goddess and rebuild her worship.
notes: Aired April to July 2023 (Studio Palette). Played-for-laughs sexual humour and fanservice per episode summaries. Based on a light novel.

title: Love After World Domination (Koi wa Sekai Seifuku no Ato de)
synopsis: The leader of a hero team and a fighter from the rival villain organisation secretly fall for each other and start dating while hiding it from their groups.
notes: Aired April to June 2022. Light comedy; some mild fanservice possible but I found nothing noted.

title: Spare Me, Great Lord!
synopsis: Based on a Chinese web novel, an ordinary student gains a power that turns negative emotions aimed at him into strength, and he is dragged into a world of supernatural events.

title: Cheating Craft
synopsis: In a society that sorts people by exams, students who study and students who cheat compete and sometimes team up to pass the tests.
notes: Aired October to December 2016. Probably a short-episode series; runtime not found.

title: UQ Holder! Mahou Sensei Negima! 2
synopsis: A boy is turned into a vampire after being mortally wounded protecting his guardian and joins a secret society of immortals and spirits.
notes: TV run was 12 episodes (Oct to Dec 2017) plus 3 OADs. Sequel to Negima!. Ecchi tag is a judgement call: it is by the author of Love Hina and Negima and the page mentions sexual relationships, but it does not label the anime ecchi.

title: Katsugeki / Touken Ranbu
synopsis: In 1863 Japan, living swords brought to life by a summoner try to stop a time-travelling enemy army from changing history.
notes: Not to be confused with the earlier Touken Ranbu: Hanamaru series, which is a separate, lighter show.

title: Akudama Drive
synopsis: In a dystopian Japan, a gang of criminals is hired for a train heist while an ordinary young woman is forced to pose as one of them.
notes: Aired October to December 2020. Violent.

title: The King's Avatar (Quanzhi Gaoshou)
synopsis: A top esports player is pushed out of his team and starts again from scratch in the online game Glory, aiming to return to the top.
notes: Chinese donghua. Season 1 has 12 eps, season 2 has 12 and season 3 has 17 (41 in total) plus an OVA and specials. There is also a separate live-action version (2019), so check you want the animated one. I could not confirm whether more is c

title: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead
synopsis: After a zombie outbreak hits Tokyo, an overworked office worker is relieved to be free of his job and makes a bucket list of things to do before he turns.
notes: Aired July to December 2023 (delayed). Also has a live-action Netflix film.

title: Fog Hill of the Five Elements (Wu Shan Wu Xing)
synopsis: In an old legend, officials chosen to gain mastery of the five elements from monsters must first cross dangerous fog-covered mountains.
notes: Chinese ONA. Per MyAnimeList: season 1 has 3 episodes (2020, about 26 min) and season 2 has 4 episodes (2023, about 38 min), so 7 total. Some sources date the first release to 2019. The same note line also mentions Blast of Tempest and Link

title: Banished from the Hero's Party, I Decided to Live a Quiet Life in the Countryside
synopsis: A hero party member kicked out for being a burden starts a quiet new life as an apothecary in a frontier town, but his past catches up with him.
notes: Season 1 (13 eps, Oct 2021) and season 2 (12 eps, Jan 2024).

title: Dohna Dohna: Issho ni Warui Koto Shiyo (Let's Do Bad Things Together)
notes: This appears to be an adult PC game (eroge, Japan 2020, English 2021), not a series or anime, and it is the only match I found for the name. Wikipedia mentions sexual violence and trafficking themes and some characters described as students

title: Tales from the Loop
synopsis: Residents of a small Ohio town live beside an underground physics research facility, and each episode follows neighbours whose lives are touched by strange phenomena.
notes: Amazon Prime Video series, one season. Episodes run about 50 to 57 minutes (54 is a midpoint). Based on Simon Stalenhag's art book.

title: Hitori no Shita: The Outcast (Yi Ren Zhi Xia)
synopsis: A college student returns to his home village after his grandfather's death and is dragged into a hidden world of people with supernatural powers. Rival factions all want the ability he has inherited.
notes: Chinese donghua based on the manhua Yi Ren Zhi Xia; Hitori no Shita is the Japanese reading. Episode count is season 1 only; sequels exist (Yi Ren Zhi Xia 2, MAL 35333, and more) and were not counted.

title: Automata
synopsis: In a future where nearly all life has died off, an insurance investigator discovers that someone is tampering with the robots that serve humanity. His search puts him at odds with his own employer.
notes: Spanish-Bulgarian film starring Antonio Banderas. Runtime is 110 min per Wikipedia (some sources say 109).

title: Pain Hustlers
synopsis: A young woman with few prospects takes a job at a struggling pharmaceutical company in Florida and gets drawn into a shady sales scheme.
notes: Netflix original film.

title: Rat Race
synopsis: A casino owner stages a cross-country race for a big cash prize, and six groups of mismatched travelers scramble to be first. Chaos follows every route.

title: Point Break (1991)
synopsis: A rookie FBI agent goes undercover among surfers he suspects of being a team of bank robbers. He grows close to their charismatic leader.
notes: Ambiguous: there is a 1991 original and a 2015 remake. Assumed the 1991 original; check which one is meant. The JustWatch IE page that was fetched appears to be the 2015 remake and showed rent/buy only.

title: Rokka: Braves of the Six Flowers (Rokka no Yuusha)
noted_as: Rokka: Braves of the Six Flowers
synopsis: Six heroes are chosen to fight a returning demon god, but when they gather there are seven of them. A self-proclaimed strongman is suspected of being the impostor and has to find the real one.

title: The Irregular at Magic High School (Mahouka Koukou no Rettousei)
synopsis: In a world where magic is taught like a technical subject, two siblings enrol at an elite school. The brother is ranked low on paper but hides exceptional skill and knowledge.
notes: Episode count (26) is season 1 only. A 2nd season (Visitor Arc) and a 3rd season (MAL 50713) exist. There is also a Mahouka movie (The Girl Who Calls the Stars).

title: The Kingdoms of Ruin (Hametsu no Oukoku)
synopsis: An empire sets out to wipe out witches, and a young apprentice loses his teacher in the purge. Consumed by grief, he vows revenge on humanity.
notes: Rated 17+ for violence and language. A second season status was not checked.

title: Goblin Slayer
synopsis: A veteran adventurer devotes himself to hunting goblins, the weakest monsters, and refuses to take on anything else. He ends up helping a group of new adventurers.
notes: Poster and MAL page are for season 2 (12 eps, 2023). Season 1 (12 eps, 2018) is assumed to be 12 episodes; not fetched from its own page. Dark, gory fantasy with sexual violence themes (episode 1 especially). A prequel film, Goblin's Crown,

title: Shangri-La Frontier
synopsis: A gamer who loves terrible games decides to try a hugely popular VR title. His odd playstyle and old habits make him stand out fast.
notes: Two seasons of 25 episodes each; a third season is listed on MAL (id 61338).

title: Lord of Mysteries (Guimi Zhi Zhu)
synopsis: A man wakes up in the body of a stranger in a Victorian-style world of steam technology and occult danger. He is caught between rival churches and hidden powers.
notes: Chinese donghua adapted from the web novel. The 13-episode first season aired June-Aug 2025; a sequel (Wu Mian Ren Pian) and side-story shorts exist.

title: Azuki Elementals
synopsis: An animated project tied to the Azuki NFT brand, announced with a teaser from a London animation studio. Plot details are not public.
notes: Best guess for the misspelling: Azuki Elementals. Only an announcement and teaser were found, with no release date, episode count or platform. Check this is what you meant.

title: Rebel Moon - Part One: A Child of Fire
synopsis: A former soldier hiding on a remote farming moon recruits warriors to defend the villagers against a ruthless empire.
notes: Two films: Part One (2023, 134 min) and Part Two: The Scargiver (2024, 122 min). Extended R-rated director's cuts also exist (Chapter One: Chalice of Blood, 204 min; Chapter Two: Curse of Forgiveness, 173 min).

title: Expend4bles (The Expendables 4)
synopsis: The mercenary team goes after a villain planning to start a world war with stolen warheads, with some new recruits joining the squad.
notes: Official title is stylised Expend4bles.

title: Kraven the Hunter
synopsis: The son of a ruthless crime boss turns into a feared hunter after a brush with death. He sets out against his own father when his family is threatened.

title: The Marsh King's Daughter
synopsis: A woman raised in the wilderness by her abductor father has built a quiet life. When he escapes custody, she must face him to protect her family.
notes: Your note says Anime, but this is a live-action 2023 film starring Daisy Ridley. No anime of that name was found. Based on the Karen Dionne novel.

title: The Bikeriders
synopsis: Set from 1965, it follows a Chicago motorcycle club as it slowly turns from a friendly brotherhood into something violent. The story is told through a woman close to one of its members.
notes: Premiered at Telluride in 2023; general release was 2024.

title: The Marvels
synopsis: Three heroes whose powers are linked find themselves swapping places whenever they use them. They team up to stop a threat tearing holes in space.
notes: Marvel film that follows Captain Marvel and the shows WandaVision and Ms. Marvel. Likely on Disney+, but no URL could be checked.

title: The Fall Guy
synopsis: A stuntman sidelined by injury returns to work on his ex's directing debut. When the lead actor vanishes, he is pulled into a plot that blames him.
notes: Your note says March 1, 2024; it premiered at SXSW on March 12, 2024 and released in the US on May 3, 2024. There is also a 1980s TV series of the same name.

title: Fire Force (Enen no Shouboutai)
synopsis: In a world where people can burst into flames and become monsters, a special fire brigade fights them. A young fire-wielder joins up to find out what happened to his family.
notes: Counts: S1 24 eps, S2 24, S3 Part 1 12, S3 Part 2 13 (aired Jan-Apr 2026). Whether more is coming was not checked.

title: The Eminence in Shadow (Kage no Jitsuryokusha ni Naritakute!)
synopsis: A fan of hidden-mastermind fiction is reborn in a magical world and secretly plays the shadowy power behind the scenes. The conspiracy he invented turns out to be real.
notes: Season 1 is 20 eps, season 2 is 12 eps; a movie (Zankyou-hen) is also listed on MAL. Further seasons not checked. UK JustWatch also listed Disney+ for the UK, not confirmed for Ireland.

title: The Family Plan
synopsis: A mild-mannered car salesman is revealed to be a former assassin. He takes his family on the run from his old employers.
notes: A sequel, The Family Plan 2, came out 21 Nov 2025. Runtime 119 min per Wikipedia (other sources say 118).

title: Tales of Zestiria the X (Tales of Zestiria the Cross)
synopsis: A young man raised among spirit beings is asked to become a Shepherd who can purify a world sinking into darkness. He has to balance human and spirit worlds.
notes: Season 1 is 12 eps (2016), season 2 is 13 eps (2017, MAL 34086). Based on the video game.

title: Hamatora The Animation
synopsis: A detective agency staffed by people with minor supernatural powers takes on cases that all seem to link to a killer targeting people like them.
notes: The follow-up series is Re:Hamatora (12 eps, MAL 23421).

title: Ultramarine Magmell (Gunjou no Magmell)
synopsis: On a newly found continent full of dangerous wildlife, a skilled rescuer and his assistant take on jobs to help people in trouble.

title: Parasyte -the maxim- (Kiseijuu: Sei no Kakuritsu)
synopsis: Alien parasites take over human brains, but one fails and ends up living in a teenager's hand. The two have to cooperate to survive.
notes: Gory horror. Not to be confused with the live-action Netflix series Parasyte: The Grey (2024) or the live-action films.

title: Tsukimichi: Moonlit Fantasy
synopsis: A teenager is summoned to another world, judged useless by the goddess who called him and sent off to a barren wasteland. His hidden power turns out to be huge, and he ends up leading a community of monsters and demihumans.
notes: S1 12 eps (2021), S2 25 eps (2024). Season 3 confirmed per article, release date not announced as of the sources found.

title: Wise Man's Grandchild (Kenja no Mago)
synopsis: A modern-day office worker is reborn in a fantasy kingdom and raised by a legendary mage. Overpowered but socially clueless, he heads to a magic academy and quickly becomes a local celebrity.
notes: Only one season so far; MAL lists no sequel.

title: Arthur the King
synopsis: An adventure racing team takes on a gruelling multi-day race, and a stray dog adopts the captain and follows them across the course. Based on a true story.
notes: Slashfilm reports a Netflix debut on 11 Aug 2026, but the regions are not stated (article only cites US viewership).

title: The Regime
synopsis: Inside the palace of a fictional European country, a paranoid chancellor leans on a volatile soldier as her government starts to crumble.
notes: Episodes run roughly 48 to 51 minutes. HBO/Max show.

title: Monkey Man
synopsis: A young man from the margins of Indian society goes after the corrupt powerful people who wronged him, using brutal fighting skills and a hidden identity.
notes: Violent action. Directed by and starring Dev Patel. Netflix originally bought it, then Universal took it over.

title: The Ministry of Ungentlemanly Warfare
synopsis: During WWII, a small band of misfit soldiers is sent on a deniable mission to sabotage enemy supply ships. It is loosely based on a real secret British unit.
notes: Guy Ritchie film. Runtime from memory (about 2h). Time Out article is from July 2024, so check it is still on Prime.

title: Ninja Kamui
synopsis: A man who walked away from a ninja clan lives quietly under a new name until the clan tracks him down. He is forced to fight back using a mysterious powered suit.
notes: MAL id 56285 inferred from a mirror site; not opened. Very violent. Aired on Adult Swim Toonami (12 eps, Feb to Apr 2024). Not on Crunchyroll per ITV article.

title: Villains Inc.
synopsis: Three jobless henchpeople try to start their own evil business after their boss is gone. Superheroes, rival villains and strict union rules keep getting in the way.
notes: Assumed to be the 2024 comedy film (dir. Jeremy Warner), the only match found; no anime of this name found. Runtime from the Prime Video page (1h44).

title: Towa no Quon (Eternal Quon)
synopsis: A theatrical anime series about people with special powers, a secretive organisation that hunts them, and a teenager caught in between. By Studio Bones.
notes: Takes 'Eternal Quon' to be Towa no Quon, released as six linked films in 2011 to 2012. MAL page opened was part 6 only (48 min, 26 Nov 2011); runtime of the full set not verified.

title: Concrete Revolutio: Choujin Gensou
synopsis: In an alternate Japan full of superhumans, a government agent turns on his own agency and becomes a fugitive. The story deals with politics and what it means to have powers in society.
notes: Assumed from 'Concrete revolution'. There is a separate sequel entry, 'Concrete Revolutio: Choujin Gensou - The Last Song' (MAL 32313), not counted in episodes or seasons.

title: Inuyashiki: Last Hero
synopsis: A neglected, ailing older man is turned into a powerful machine after a strange incident. He uses his new abilities to help people while another survivor of the same event does the opposite.
notes: Graphic violence and gore. There is also a 2018 live-action film.

title: The Holdovers
synopsis: At a New England boarding school in the 1970s, a stern teacher, a grieving cook and a troubled student are left behind over the Christmas break and slowly form a bond.
notes: Runtime from memory.

title: The Boy and the Heron
synopsis: A boy who has lost his mother is drawn into a strange other world by a talking heron. Studio Ghibli film directed by Hayao Miyazaki.
notes: Runtime from memory.

title: Maniac
synopsis: Two strangers join a mysterious pharmaceutical trial that promises to fix their problems, and their shared experimental dreams get stranger and stranger.
notes: Assumed the 2018 Netflix miniseries (Emma Stone, Jonah Hill) given the sci-fi list it sits in. Episode count from memory.

title: The Man Who Fell to Earth
noted_as: The Man Who Fell to Earth
synopsis: An alien arrives on Earth on a mission to save his home world, and a scientist and a former engineer get pulled into his plans. A modern series based on the same story as the 1976 film.
notes: Assumed the 2022 Showtime series (Chiwetel Ejiofor), not the 1976 Bowie film. Episode count from memory; it ended after one season.

title: Devs
synopsis: A software engineer investigates the secretive quantum computing division of her employer after her partner vanishes. Created by Alex Garland.
notes: FX on Hulu limited series.

title: Severance
synopsis: Employees at a mysterious company have a procedure that splits their work memories from their personal lives. One of them starts to question what the company is really doing.
notes: S1 9 eps, S2 10 eps (from memory). Season 3 renewed, filming Apr to Dec 2026, estimated release mid to late 2027.

title: Scavengers Reign
synopsis: The surviving crew of a wrecked cargo ship are scattered across a hostile alien planet and must adapt to its bizarre ecosystem.
notes: Adult animation, cancelled by Max after one season.

title: Enemy
synopsis: A history professor spots an actor who looks exactly like him in a film and becomes obsessed with finding him. Directed by Denis Villeneuve, starring Jake Gyllenhaal.
notes: Contains some disturbing imagery; some sexual content. Runtime from memory.

title: Frieren: Beyond Journey's End
synopsis: After defeating the Demon King, a long-lived elf mage realises she never really got to know her human friends before they aged. She sets off on a new journey to understand people.
notes: S1 28 eps; S2 listed with 10 eps on MAL (aired early 2026). A further entry (Ougonkyou-hen) is listed, so more is coming.

title: Sasaki and Peeps (Sasaki to Pii-chan)
synopsis: A middle-aged office worker adopts a talking bird that is secretly a reincarnated wizard, which opens a door between our world and a fantasy one. He gets swept into secret missions.

synopsis: A sage who died of old age is reborn centuries later as a small child with his memories and strong magic intact. He enters a magic academy in a world where magic has weakened.
notes: Premiered July 2026 (EMT Squared, Crunchyroll). Infobox said 5 episodes but the table lists up to episode 10, so the count is not verified.

title: Space Sweepers
synopsis: In 2092, a crew of scrappy space-junk collectors finds a child who could be a weapon. They get caught between corporate villains and their own debts.
notes: South Korean film, 2021 (Netflix).

title: Jung_E
synopsis: In a future ravaged by war, a company works to turn a legendary soldier's brain into an AI for combat. Sci-fi action from the director of Train to Busan.
notes: South Korean film (Netflix), Jan 2023.

title: Warriors of Future
synopsis: In a future where Earth is hit by environmental collapse and alien-like threats, soldiers fight to protect humanity. A Hong Kong sci-fi action film with heavy CGI.
notes: Hong Kong film, 2022 (Netflix release Dec 2022). Synopsis is general since the page gave no plot detail. Note wording 'Warriors of Future' matches the official title; I resolved it to this film.

title: Alienoid
synopsis: Sorcerers in medieval Korea and aliens in the present day are linked by a time-travelling prison escape. A genre-mixing sci-fi action film.
notes: South Korean, 2022. Has a sequel, Alienoid: Return to the Future (Jan 2024).

title: The Wandering Earth
synopsis: With the Sun dying, humanity builds giant engines to push Earth out of the solar system to a new star. Chinese blockbuster based on a Liu Cixin story.
notes: Chinese film, 2019. The Wandering Earth 2 (2023) is a prequel.

title: Mangrove
synopsis: A courtroom drama about the 1970 trial of Black activists in London after a protest against police harassment at the Mangrove restaurant.
notes: Assumed to be Steve McQueen's Mangrove (2020), the first film of the Small Axe anthology (BBC/Amazon). Note had only one word, so other titles named Mangrove are possible.
